title: Startup of the evaluation phase
statement: Let $x$ and $u$ be binary words, and suppose the exact-consumption parser for CNF formulas succeeds on $x$. Then there is a number of steps $t\le 4(|\langle x,u\rangle|+2)$ such that the verifier started in its initial configuration on the paired input $\langle x,u\rangle$ reaches the formula-level evaluation state with no input bits consumed, work tape storing $u$ from cell $0$, work head at $0$, and empty output.
replaced:
Let $x$ be a binary string on which the exact-consumption formula parser succeeds, and
let $u$ be any binary word. Then for some $t \le 4(|\mathrm{pair}(x,u)| + 2)$, running
the non-tautology verifier for $t$ steps from its initial configuration on
$\mathrm{pair}(x,u)$ reaches the formula-level evaluation state with no input bits
consumed, $u$ on the work tape from cell $0$, the work head at cell $0$, and empty
output.
